paragraphs: AI/ML Engineer with 4+ years of experience developing production machine learning and generative AI systems, specializing in AI reliability, LLM evaluation and scalable inference infrastructure.

At C3 AI I architect a multi-tenant LLM and RAG inference platform for 20+ enterprise deployments, design LangGraph orchestration workflows with automated validation gates, and run evaluation and drift monitoring that catches model regressions 4x faster. Before that I tuned semantic ranking and RAG retrieval for enterprise search at Glean, and shipped forecasting, NLP and recommendation models at Accenture.

I care about AI systems you can trust: answers checked claim by claim against their sources, fine-tuned models aligned with preference data, and results backed by evaluations defined before the run. I hold an M.S. in Computer Science and Engineering from the University at Buffalo.
